stage: A (discovery on the bhavcopy-era sessions); not validated

data_window.note: The engineered features table starts on 2025-12-29; earlier sessions are not scored with missing inputs, they are not evaluated.

assumptions.entry: open of the session after the signal session (the first executable price after an end-of-day signal)
assumptions.exit: close of the session h sessions after the signal session
assumptions.price_basis: split/bonus-adjusted cash prices as a proxy for the near-month future (basis and roll are not modelled)

costs.basis: assumed percent of notional per round trip in a stock future; statutory about 0.03, brokerage about 0.02, slippage and spread about 0.10; not a tax computation

assumptions.splits: discovery 60% / validation 20% / test 20% by signal session, forward window kept inside the split

tested_configurations.note: Every variant, category, horizon and split evaluated is counted; the threshold winners were chosen on discovery only and frozen before validation and test.

limitations: Stage A only: nothing is validated. Stage B tests the frozen set on Kite's older daily history; Stage C is live shadow validation.
About one year (the features table starts 2025-12-29): a few hundred independent sessions at best, and forward windows overlap (Newey-West errors are used).
Outcomes use adjusted cash prices as a proxy for the near-month future; basis, roll and the lot size are not modelled.
The cost is an assumed round-trip percentage, not a tax computation; the stress cost doubles it.
OI change in the scan is summed over every expiry (the production definition), not the near-month contract alone.
The candidate engine cannot score options-chain confirmation for stocks yet, so every candidate's Signal Strength coverage is at most 85%.
F&O membership is the set of stocks the scan lists that day (point in time); historical NIFTY and BANKNIFTY constituents are not available, so no constituent-based analysis is made.
OI percentile is not in the grid: it needs OI history that the first sessions do not have; it belongs to a second pass on the frozen set.

protocol.selected_on: discovery split only, by net t-statistic
